summary: The 2026 AI coding landscape is dominated by a handful of mature tools that blend inline completion with full agentic autonomy. GitHub Copilot remains the broadest-adopted default thanks to deep IDE and enterprise integration, while Cursor and Claude Code have surged among professional developers for agentic, multi-file work. Beyond the leaders, a competitive cluster of vendor-backed and cloud-native agents (OpenAI Codex, Devin, Amazon Q, Gemini Code Assist) continues to expand adoption rapidly.

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
strengths: Widest IDE and provider support including multi-model selector
Agent Mode with cloud agents that open PRs
Largest installed base and enterprise reach
tools.best_for: Pragmatic everyday coding with the broadest ecosystem and enterprise governance

tools.name: Cursor
strengths: Fast inline diffs and multi-file edits with approval
Multiple model providers with in-editor switching
tools.best_for: Default AI IDE for everyday shipping and rapid iteration

tools.name: Claude Code
tools.pricing_paid: Included with Claude Pro $20/mo and Max $100–200/mo; API usage-based
strengths: Autonomously edits files and runs shell commands
tools.best_for: Complex, autonomous multi-step coding tasks requiring deep reasoning

tools.name: OpenAI Codex
tools.pricing_paid: Included with ChatGPT Plus $20/mo, Pro $200/mo; API usage-based
strengths: Cloud-based agentic coding with parallel tasks
Strong code generation from frontier models
tools.best_for: Delegating parallel coding tasks to a cloud agent within the OpenAI ecosystem

tools.name: Gemini Code Assist
strengths: Generous free tier with high completion limits
Large context window via Gemini models
Deep Google Cloud and Firebase integration
Agentic capabilities in IDE and CLI
tools.best_for: Google Cloud-centric teams wanting a strong free tier

tools.name: Amazon Q Developer
tools.best_for: AWS-centric development, migrations, and cloud infrastructure work

tools.name: Devin Desktop
strengths: End-to-end task completion with its own environment
tools.best_for: Delegating complete, autonomous engineering tasks to an AI agent

tools.name: RooCode
tools.pricing_paid: Free extension; pay for underlying model API usage (BYO key)
tools.best_for: Reliable, large-scale autonomous code changes with full model control

tools.name: Cline
tools.pricing_paid: Free extension; pay for underlying model API usage (BYO key)
tools.best_for: Open-source agentic coding with full transparency and model choice

tools.name: Tabnine
strengths: Code-completion and chat with permissive-license models
tools.best_for: Privacy-sensitive and regulated enterprises needing self-hosted AI coding
